name: EEGNet (Sleep Staging)
description: This EEGNet model is designed for high-accuracy binary sleep staging (Wake vs Sleep). It was specifically trained on the 'Fpz-Cz' and 'Pz-Oz' channels. These channels were selected because the frontal region (Fpz-Cz) perfectly captures slow-wave sleep, while the occipital region (Pz-Oz) captures the prominent alpha waves of wakefulness. Note: You are free to experiment with any two channels, but the model's accuracy (97.2%) may significantly decrease if the recommended channels are not used.
